description: 5-Fold Cross-Validation benchmark comparing linear weighted sum, hand-crafted Mamdani fuzzy rules, and GA-tuned fuzzy model

overfitting_risk_analysis.vulnerability_with_small_sample_size: With sample sizes of N=8 to 30 road segments, unconstrained optimization algorithms (such as full gradient backpropagation on unconstrained neuro-fuzzy parameters) would rapidly overfit to idiosyncrasies of specific raters or single road stretches.
regularization_and_architectural_safegua: Constrained parameter space: We tune only 20 rule weights (bounded in [0.1, 1.8]) and 4 macro membership boundaries.
K-Fold Cross-Validation: Folds strictly partition training and testing segments; test segments are never seen during GA tuning.
Bounded Gene Drift: Membership parameters use hard upper/lower bounds preventing degenerate or inverted fuzzy membership sets.
overfitting_risk_analysis.viva_defense_summary: The GA-tuned fuzzy model achieves generalization by refining rule priorities rather than memorizing data points.
